'''All Good Things Traditional''' is the 59th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 7 November 2025. The set consists of 41 virtual cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*4 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*3 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*3 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*21 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Bajoran, 10 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 3 Klingon and 7 Non-Aligned)
*7 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 3 Federation and 3 Non-Aligned)

'''NOTE:''' There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*41 [[:Category:Traditional Promo (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Traditional Promo]]
